title: Honbako

manga.work: ブラックジャックによろしく / Give My Regards to Black Jack
manga.author: 佐藤秀峰 / Shuho Sato

acts.copy: HONBAKO / 本箱 / The manga reader with MCP built in.

shots.what: Title page: HONBAKO, 本箱 and “The manga reader with MCP built in.”; the vermilion 本箱 seal is stamped at 1.45 s (lands slightly large and settles, no shake).

acts.copy: 01 — LIBRARY: All your manga, in one library.

shots.what: Closed Duo fades in with dimension lines: 84.1 mm × 117.8 mm.
The hinge opens 0°→180° (the model's own fold clip) to the library; dimension line 164.6 mm.

Axonometric view: the device tips back and turns slightly, with the screen in place. Leaders: INNER DISPLAY 7.6 in; IPHONE DUO 164.6 × 117.8 mm open. LOCAL FILES — Import CBZ files and folders from Files.
Push to Settings → Personal Server. PERSONAL SERVER — Connect your Komga, Kavita or Suwayomi library.
Push to Settings → Extensions. EXTENSIONS — Add sources with extensions you choose. Footnote: Honbako doesn’t provide manga. Sources and their content are your responsibility.

acts.copy: 02 — YOUR AI: Ask your own AI about what you’re reading.

shots.what: English Vol. 1 pp. 23–24 in the reader. IN YOUR AI APP: user asks for a recap; AI card streams the recap, labelled ILLUSTRATIVE DEMONSTRATION.
Second question; the answer card is joined by a leader to the panel that honbako_annotate_page marked (real app output), ANNOTATED BY YOUR AI, with a vermilion pulse.

Settings → MCP Server permissions recording; a tap turns on Read Reading History and Progress. MCP SERVER — Bring your own AI. Connect the AI app you already use through Honbako’s MCP server. You choose what it can see. Footnote: provider account separate; requests sync while Honbako is open; approval for adding books and changing sources.

acts.copy: 03 — JAPANESE: Help with Japanese, right on the page. [HONBAKO PRO]

shots.what: Japanese Vol. 7 spread; romaji wipe right-to-left; camera pushes in with a scale bar measuring 10 mm of the device at the current zoom. ROMAJI — Romaji aligned to each character.
A tap on 実験台じゃない opens Read This Phrase. READ THIS PHRASE — Tap a phrase for its reading and pronunciation.

acts.copy: 04 — IPHONE DUO: Made for iPhone Duo. / Back to your page in one tap.

shots.what: Page curl recording. PAGE TURNS — Paper-like page turns, one spread at a time.
The open device turns around to show the cover on the outer display. COVER DISPLAY — While you read, the outer display shows the cover [HONBAKO PRO]. Footnote: camera use, nothing recorded.
Resume widget (sample book). RESUME WIDGET — Opens your book at your page. Your place syncs with iCloud.

acts.copy: HONBAKO / Your manga. Your AI. / A little company on every page.

shots.what: The seal is stamped again; end card: Some features require Honbako Pro. Compatible AI-provider account required. Manga credit.

music: tools/music.py: single felt-piano notes over a quiet pad in D major on a slow 72 BPM grid, one chord per feature, higher register for the Japanese section, a low octave under each seal stamp, held add9 under the end card. About −16 LUFS. No sound effects.
device: Apple's iPhone Duo model (V68.usdz from Xcode 27.1's DeviceHub plugin), Dark finish, rendered per frame by tools/duo-render with RealityKit; hinge posed with the model's book_close clip.

style.idea: Paper and ink with one vermilion seal: a title page, four sections with labelled features, and an end card. Inspired by monochrome technical-book films; no handheld shake, no glitch or decay effects. Smooth eased moves and crossfades only. Copy is plain product language.

palette.seal: #C23B22 (vermilion, used only for marks: the 本箱 seal, taps, and the place the AI marks on the page)

style.device: Apple iPhone Duo model (V68.usdz) rendered per frame; in section 01 it tips back 50° and turns 16° into an axonometric view, with leaders labelled INNER DISPLAY (7.6 in) and IPHONE DUO (164.6 × 117.8 mm open). Dimension lines use Apple's published measurements.
style.screens: Genuine captures, shown in full colour; only the world around them is paper and ink.
